decision.message: The esp32_bmp280_v1 board family supports only a regulated supply voltage range of 3.2 to 3.4 V. Directly accepting 12 V at J1 without an external converter is not supported.

clauses.text: Make the pressure controller accept a regulated 12 V supply directly at J1 without an external converter.
clauses.reason: Whole original request retained; no design is authorized. The esp32_bmp280_v1 board family supports only a regulated supply voltage range of 3.2 to 3.4 V. Directly accepting 12 V at J1 without an external converter is not supported.

The existing esp32_bmp280_v1 board family only supports an external regulated supply of 3.2–3.4 V. Accepting a regulated 12 V supply directly at J1 without an external converter exceeds the maximum allowed supply voltage and is outside the described family envelope.
clauses.text: Make the pressure controller accept a regulated 12 V supply directly at J1 without an external converter.
